title: Burbank → Chania
blurb: Heading out Monday afternoon from Burbank. We land in Chania late Tuesday night.
plan: Fly out Monday afternoon from Burbank and land in Chania late Tuesday. Keep the first night easy — bags, a late bite, sleep.

title: Chania, Crete
blurb: Slow days by the harbour, and the Saturday market — Mercato del Sabato.
plan: Ease into Crete. Harbour walks, a coffee in the old town, and Saturday’s market. No car yet — stay close and eat well.

title: Paleochora
blurb: Down to the south coast. We pick up a car in Chania that morning, and plan to visit Elafonissi Beach.
plan: Pick up the car in Chania and take the south-coast roads to Paleochora. Elafonissi if the day is kind — pink sand, a long swim, a slow drive back.

title: Douliana
blurb: Three nights in a mountain village inland from the north coast.
plan: Three quiet nights in the hills. Village walks, a taverna table, and a swim on the north coast if we want one.

title: Elounda
blurb: Two nights on the northeast coast, near Agios Nikolaos.
plan: Two nights in Elounda. Spinalonga if we feel like the boat, an easy evening by the water, nothing rushed.

title: Heraklion
blurb: Last stretch on Crete. We drop the car here on the 6th. One stop that matters to us: Saint Minas Cathedral, a family site.
plan: Drop the car. Saint Minas Cathedral — family ground — then the old town, a market wander, and a last Cretan dinner before the ferry.

title: Heraklion → Santorini
plan: WORLDCHAMPION JET, Club class. Heraklion 8:00, Santorini 9:35. At the port early, then up from Athinios to the caldera.

title: Santorini
plan: Caldera light, an Oia wander before the crush, a winery for Assyrtiko, and dinners with a view. Heat in the middle of the day — we slow down.

title: Santorini → Athens
plan: EUROCHAMPION JET 2. Santorini 12:55, Piraeus 18:30. A long, easy crossing, then into Athens for the night.

title: Athens
blurb: Last days in the city. The Parthenon, a few museums, and hunting for hidden bars in the Plaka. Homeward on the 17th.
plan: Acropolis in a cooler hour, a museum or two, Plaka and hidden bars, and enough time left to just sit. Nothing packed tight.

title: Athens → Burbank
blurb: Early start from Athens. Back in Burbank that evening.
plan: Early start from Athens. A travel day, then home to Burbank that evening.
